title: feat(spec): declare the recycle-bin surface: the sys_recycle_bin entry contract, the retention hook, the restore refusals, the restored event and two grant keys (ADR-0148)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu8iKZzw1r2XCrNituG3deMH)_

Fixes #30235

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #30237 — `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` teaches that the trash surface is retired and that there is no recycle bin (the `apiMethods` section and the delete note); both stay true after this PR, which declares and reads nothing, so the rewrite rides the engine slice that ships the reader.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 `@objectstack/spec` 里声明回收站的契约：`sys_recycle_bin` 条目的字段表与值形状、宿主保留期钩子（只认天数）、三个恢复拒绝码、`data.record.restored` 事件名、两个对象权限键；运行时一行未动。
- 为什么改：ADR-0148 D5 把这些拼写交给本卡，引擎（#30237）和控制台（#30239）要在它上面建；没有它，删除仍然不可恢复。
- 风险与回滚：纯新增，可选键无默认值，已有元数据和已解析的权限条目不变；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/recycle-bin.zod.ts`（钩子签名与拒绝文案）、`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`（两个新键）、`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`（三个拒绝码先于生产者登记）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local src/data/recycle-bin.zod.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、16 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The spec half of the recycle bin ([ADR-0148](docs/adr/0148-recycle-bin-separate-store-restore-under-original-ids-retention-in-days.md) D5, Rollout step 2; ruling 6629858351 on #3146, D7's eight choices ratified 6659364907 on #30234). Every name below is **declared here and read elsewhere**: nothing in this PR writes or reads the bin, and every delete is still a physical delete.

- **`packages/spec/src/data/recycle-bin.zod.ts`** (new, exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`):
  - `RECYCLE_BIN_OBJECT` = `'sys_recycle_bin'` and `RECYCLE_BIN_ENTRY_FIELDS`, the entry's one field list (`id`, `object_name`, `record_id`, `record_count`, `snapshot`, `deleted_by`, `deleted_at`, `retention_days`, `purge_after`), all read-only; `RecycleBinEntrySchema` is its value shape, key for key. The object file, its plugin registration and its `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE` row are the engine slice's (seat decision 2): that registry means "a table exists".
  - `RecycleBinSnapshotSchema` (with `RecycleBinSnapshotRowSchema`, `RecycleBinClearedReferenceSchema`): the cascade set, master first, secret-channel refs left out (D4), plus the `set_null` references the delete cleared (D2's re-link rule).
  - The retention hook (D3): `RecycleBinRetentionResolver = (token: string | undefined) => number | undefined`, the same token type `resolveFeatures` takes in `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts`; `RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS_ENV` = `'OS_RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS'`, `RECYCLE_BIN_DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS` = 30; `RecycleBinRetentionDaysSchema` / `RecycleBinRetentionDaysEnvSchema` refuse zero and every non-whole-number with `recycleBinRetentionRefusal(source, value)`, which names the source and the fix and no plan.
  - `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_CODES` (three codes) and `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_STATUS` = 409.
  - `RECORD_RESTORED_EVENT` = `'data.record.restored'`, a spec constant only (seat decision 1): `DataEventType` / `RealtimeEventType` list emitted events, so it joins them in the change that emits it.
  - `RECYCLE_BIN_GRANT_KEYS`.
- **Error-code ledger** (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`): `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN`, `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED`, `RESTORE_PACKAGE_UNINSTALLED` under `@objectstack/objectql`, ahead of their producer (seat decision 4).
- **Object permissions** (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`): `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` and `manageRecycleBin`, optional with no default, so no parsed entry grows a key. Both enter `liveness/permission.json` as `planned`, naming their readers (#30237 evaluator mapping and engine doors, #30239 Console) (seat decision 3). The tombstoned `allowRestore` / `allowPurge` stay refused.
- **Regenerated artifacts**: api-surface, export-origins, declaration-map, authorable-surface, json-schema manifest, `content/docs/references/**`, the strictness-ledger counts, liveness state counts, `llms.txt`, and the type-alias pin (+6 isomorphic pins, 831 → 837).
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` minor.

⛔ Not here: the engine's delete path, restore, purge, empty, the TTL reap, the permission mapping, the REST doors (#30237); the Console (#30239); any tombstoned key (`enable.trash`, `softDelete`, `allowRestore`, `allowPurge`, the retired `apiMethods` values).

## Why

A deleted record is gone for good today. ADR-0148 rules a separate bin store and leaves the spellings to this card (D6); the engine and Console slices build on them, and ADR-0049's enforce-or-remove gate is passed by naming each reader in its liveness row.

## Tests

All readings at head `25af14cf`, after `origin/main` `c23eafa8` was merged in and the build state refreshed.

- `packages/spec/src/data/recycle-bin.zod.test.ts` (new, 16 cases): the three names; the hook takes the `resolveFeatures` token and answers days or nothing; `RecycleBinRetentionDaysSchema` accepts 1/7/30/365 and refuses `0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, null, '30', true` with the refusal text; the env schema accepts `'1' '30' '365'` and refuses `'0' '030' '-7' '7.5' ' 7' 'thirty' ''`; the refusal names the source and the remedy and no plan; the snapshot round-trips and refuses zero rows; the field contract (types, required, read-only, `deleted_by` → `sys_user`) builds a valid `ObjectSchema` under `sys_recycle_bin`; `RecycleBinEntrySchema` matches the field keys one for one; the refusal codes are registered and answer 409; `data.record.restored` stays out of `DataEventType` / `RealtimeEventType`; the two grant keys parse, are never defaulted, and the retired `allowRestore` / `allowPurge` stay refused.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.test.ts`: the three codes parse as `ErrorCode`, sit under `@objectstack/objectql`, and need no standard-synonym waiver.
- `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`: +6 isomorphic pins (831 → 837).

## Acceptance notes

- **Resumed work, re-verified.** The previous card thread pushed five commits to `claude/project-thread-jpl1gr` (last `884764a2`). Each hunk was re-read against ADR-0148 and the seat's four decisions; all are kept. One correction: the changeset's `Clause-②:` line carried a free-text arm, and now reads `yes (widening)`, the claim's form (`25af14cf`). The net diff touches no file outside `packages/spec`, `content/docs/references/**`, `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger*` and `.changeset/`; the object file the first commit wrote under `platform-objects` was moved out by the predecessor itself (seat decision 2).
- **Why the grants are object-permission keys.** ADR-0148 D5 says `OPERATION_TO_PERMISSION` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts` must map `restore` / `purge` to the new grants; that map targets object-permission keys, so both keys live on the per-object entry. `manageRecycleBin` is bin administration on that object; emptying purges every entry the holder manages.
- **What the readers must add (the engine and Console cards, not this PR).** `EffectiveObjectPermission` (the `/auth/me/permissions` shape) gains both optional keys because it derives from the same base; nothing fills them yet. `GRANT_BITS` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, `ObjectPermissionVerbTarget` / `objectPermissionGrants` in `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`, and `CAPS` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PermissionPreview.tsx` list neither key today. Carrier: #30237 (merge, fold, evaluator map, flipping both liveness rows to `live`) and #30239 (the Console columns).
- **Strictness.** The four object sites in `recycle-bin.zod.ts` are `z.object` and triaged `wire` in the strictness ledger: persisted runtime state the engine writes and reads, never authored; the snapshot's `values` carry whatever fields the deleted rows had.
- **No ADR anchor file.** ADR-0148's id sits in the code at each declaration; no `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry was added, because the claim's file surface does not name one. The seat may ask for it.
- **Timestamps.** `deleted_at` / `purge_after` accept ISO 8601 with an offset (`datetime({ offset: true })`), a little wider than the repository's common `datetime()` form, so an engine writing a local offset is not refused.
